reference_depth_definition: LiDAR radial range r = sqrt(X^2 + Y^2 + Z^2), in metres
azimuth_definition: atan2(Y, X); zero along +X; positive from +X toward +Y
elevation_definition: atan2(Z, sqrt(X^2 + Y^2)); zero in the XY plane; positive toward +Z
angle_to_lidar_xyz: X = r*cos(el)*cos(az); Y = r*cos(el)*sin(az); Z = r*sin(el); convert az and el from degrees to radians before evaluation
